children: Air Products & Chemicals has signed a long-term supply contract with a major semiconductor manufacturer to support its chipmaking plant and production expansion in the U.S.

The industrial gases company said the agreement is with an unidentified leading semiconductor manufacturer to supply high-purity industrial gases and related infrastructure as the company scales its operations in the country.

Air Products plans to invest about $250 million in Arizona to build, own and operate new gas supply infrastructure for the customer's semiconductor manufacturing and advanced packaging operations, including new hydrogen generation units, carbon dioxide purification units and bulk gas systems.

Air Products said the latest contract marks the second recent semiconductor manufacturing supply win for the company, bringing combined capital commitments to over $900 million across the two projects.
